dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Crystal came into the QUACC as an owner surrender. In her previous home, Crystal was reported to be partially house trained, guard her food, treats, and toys by becoming tense and growling, become anxious and destructive when left alone, and lunge when her paws were touched. Crystal in the care center is a bit fearful, but has been social with select staff. As a result, we recommend Crystal is placed with one of our New Hope Partners.
dog.name: Crystal
